title: ticfac factory setup has no classifier rung: TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set by hand and never verified
body: Every other credential the factory consumes is walked by `ticfac factory setup` — one verified rung at a time, proven against the live service before it is written anywhere, mirrored in ~/.ticfacrc. The classifier's key is the exception after x0k: an operator sets it with `wrangler secret put TYPESAFE_API_KEY` and the first thing that notices a bad key is a run degrading with a recorded no-answer. A rung would verify the key with a real (cheap) classification call before storing it, the way the gateway and provider rungs verify.
